evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API change. The removed endpoints were undocumented (/internal/mcp/* server registration) and never shipped as a supported contract. The revert restores pre-#2605 behavior. The existing MCP gateway API is untouched.
evidence.documentation: No documentation changes needed. The removed feature was not documented. The MCP gateway documentation (docs/api/mcp.md) was not affected by this revert.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No manual release testing required. The change is a deletion of an undocumented internal endpoint that was never shipped as supported behavior, per the PR author's documentation assessment. The MCP server gateway (mcp_server.cpp, POST /mcp) is unaffected and was not part of this revert.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Zero post-approval commits. The single PR commit (49febe38ce) was approved at 2026-09-08T20:31:54Z and merged at 2026-09-09T14:47:32Z without any intermediate commits.
evidence.review: PR #3498 was authored by @fl0rianr (also a maintainer, though not on the MCP subject area). @jeremyfowers opened an AI-assisted task asking whether this is a faithful and complete revert of #2605; Claude returned a thorough verification finding zero residual MCP-client references. @ramkrishna2910 (member, subject-area expertise in MCP) submitted the APPROVED review with the comment 'Revert is clean. Built and tested locally.' The reviewer applied subject-matter expertise as expected. The PR checklist was completed, including local build and test confirmation.
evidence.security: No security concern. The revert removes a process-launch surface (MCP server registration could spawn arbitrary local processes) that was admin-key-gated but would have been inaccessible without an admin key on a keyless server. Removing it is a net security improvement by eliminating an attack surface. No credential handling, supply-chain changes, or suspicious code present.
evidence.tests: The revert deleted the entire test suite for the removed feature: test/cpp/test_mcp_client_config.cpp (320 lines) and test/fixtures/mock_mcp_stdio_server.py (129 lines). Updated test/cpp/test_config_dir_migration.cpp to stop expecting mcp_servers.json in migration paths. No existing tests were weakened, skipped, or deleted — the test changes are consistent with a revert. CI C++ unit tests passed successfully.
